items.title: 33.7 Pani ke wasail ki hifazat aur bachat (Roman Urdu)

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Kitab is heading ke neeche koi text nahi deti; foran 33.7.1 shuru ho jata hai. Is hisse mein pani ke zakhiron (water resources) ko bachane ke do tareeqe hain: 33.7.1 mein pollution par qaboo (pollution control), aur 33.7.2 mein pani ka kifayat se istemal (efficient use of water).

blocks.prompt: Pani ke zakhiron ko bachane ke do bare tareeqe batayein.
blocks.explanation: Pollution par qaboo (taake nuqsan-deh maddey pani mein na jayein) aur pani ka kifayat se istemal (taake pani zaya na ho).

items: Pani ki hifazat: pollution par qaboo (33.7.1) aur kifayat se istemal (33.7.2).
